claims.content: To generate reports detailing sales history and claim processing for service providers to facilitate reimbursement.

goal.raw_text: To generate reports detailing sales history and claim processing for service providers to facilitate reimbursement.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The user must be logged into the system with appropriate permissions to generate reports.
Clean claims data must have been entered into the computer database and processed for reimbursement.
Service providers must have submitted treatment documentation and summary claims forms to the VMU.
The system must have master tables populated with distributor, drug, syndrome, diagnosis, lab test, patient status, and claim status information required for reporting.
The MSIU Field Office User initiates the report generation process, likely by selecting a specific distributor or service provider to view details and sales history.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User initiates the report generation process, likely by selecting a specific distributor or service provider to view details and sales history.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User selects a particular distributor or service provider to view details, potentially by double-clicking on the grid.
The system displays the Sales History of the selected distributor with summary details including Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, and Balance Qty.

The system retrieves claim processing data linked to the selected entity, utilizing master information such as Drugs Master, Syndrome Master, Diagnosis Master, Lab Test Master, Patient Status Master, and Claim Status Master for accurate reporting.
The system generates the report containing the sales history and processed claim details for reimbursement purposes.
The user reviews the generated report, which includes the Distributor Name as the Report Header and the summary details as the report footer.
If the user attempts to print the report, the system checks the User Login Permission; if the user lacks permission, the print option is denied.
If a claim is identified as conspicuous during processing, it is flagged for investigation and clearance by the VMU before being included in the reimbursement report.

If the user attempts to generate a report for a distributor with duplicate names, the system issues a warning message advising the user to verify the correct entity or use a differentiating indicator before proceeding.
If the user attempts to delete records associated with the report generation context, the operation is blocked if child records have been created for those entries.
If the user attempts to print the generated report without the necessary User Login Permission, the system denies the print option.
A report is generated displaying the Distributor Name as the Report Header and summary details (Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, Balance Qty) as the report footer.
The system provides a provision to print the distributor master details or the generated sales history report.
If clean claims were processed, they are identified for reimbursement via bank transfer.
Conspicuous claims identified during the reporting process are flagged for investigation and clearance by the VMU.
